question: If you use your imagination to draw a magic tree, what could grow on it? 🌳✨
explanation: Super! In your imagination, you can create a magic tree that grows yummy candies and fun toys! 🍬
hint: Think of something magical that does not grow on normal trees.

question: In a dream drawing, what color could the sky be? 🌌
explanation: Awesome! When you imagine, the sky can be any fun color like purple or green! 🟪

question: If you draw a magic car, how does it travel? 🚗✨
explanation: Great job! A magic car can have wings and fly high up in the clouds! ☁️

question: What kind of pet can you draw in a fantasy world? 🐾
explanation: Super! In your imagination, animals can talk and tell you stories! 🗣️
hint: Think of an animal doing a human thing.

question: If you design a dream house, what is it made of? 🏠
explanation: Awesome! A dream house can be made of sweet chocolate and cookies! 🍪

question: What magical thing can you draw on a horse? 🐴
explanation: Great job! Adding a magical horn makes a regular horse a beautiful unicorn! 🦄

question: In a fantasy drawing, what can a friendly monster do? 👹
explanation: Super! Monsters in your imagination can be kind friends who bake yummy treats! 🍪

question: If you draw a magic boat, where does it sail? ⛵
explanation: Awesome! A fantasy boat can float softly through the fluffy clouds! ☁️

question: What can a magic pencil do in your drawing? ✏️
explanation: Great job! A magic pencil can make your wonderful drawings come to life! ✨

question: If you draw the sun on a beach, what can it wear? ☀️
explanation: Super! Giving the sun cool sunglasses makes your drawing fun and silly! 😎
hint: People wear these to protect their eyes.

question: In your imagination, what size is an elephant? 🐘
explanation: Awesome! You can imagine an elephant so small it fits in your hand! 🐜
hint: Think of a very small insect.

question: What can flowers do in a dream drawing? 🌸
explanation: Great job! Dream flowers can have faces and sing happy songs together! 🎵

question: If you invent magic shoes, what do they help you do? 👟✨
explanation: Super! Magic shoes can give you wings to fly over the trees! 🌲

question: What can you imagine a river is made of? 🌊
explanation: Awesome! A fantasy river can flow with tasty strawberry milk! 🥛

question: What does a magic cloud taste like? ☁️
explanation: Great job! A fluffy cloud can be made of sweet, pink cotton candy! 🍭

question: What can a fish do in your imagination? 🐟
explanation: Super! You can draw a fish with little legs walking in the park! 🌳
hint: What do humans do with legs?

question: In a fun drawing, what color is a cat? 🐈
explanation: Awesome! A pink cat makes your art look magical and very special! 🩷
hint: Pick a very bright, fun color.

question: If your bed is magic, what does it turn into at night? 🛏️
explanation: Great job! Your bed can fly you to the stars like a cool spaceship! ⭐

question: What do magic trees do at night? 🌳🌙
explanation: Super! Magic trees can glow like lamps to light up the dark night! 💡

question: If you draw a star, what fun thing is it doing? ⭐
explanation: Awesome! Stars in your drawing can have arms and legs to dance happily! 🕺

question: What falls from the sky in a dream rainstorm? 🌧️
explanation: Great job! A magical rainstorm can drop yummy jellybeans for you to catch! 🍬

question: If you invent a robot, what does it do for fun? 🤖
explanation: Super! You can imagine a friendly robot that bakes delicious cakes for you! 🍰

question: Where does a magic door take you? 🚪✨
explanation: Awesome! A magic door can open into a beautiful land full of fairies! 🧚‍♀️
hint: It goes to a magical place.

question: What power does a magic hat give you? 🎩
explanation: Great job! A magic hat can make you invisible to play the best hide-and-seek! 🫣

question: What does a dream bear love to do? 🐻
explanation: Super! In your drawing, a smart bear can wear glasses and read fun books! 👓

question: How can you draw a friendly snake? 🐍
explanation: Awesome! A fantasy snake can have soft, fluffy fur just like a teddy bear! 🧸
hint: Think of a teddy bear's texture.

question: How big is a magic butterfly? 🦋
explanation: Great job! You can draw a giant butterfly that you can ride in the sky! 🦋

question: What is a dream mountain made of? ⛰️
explanation: Super! A fantasy mountain can be a huge pile of tasty ice cream! 🍦

question: What do you use a magic umbrella for? ☂️
explanation: Awesome! You can turn an umbrella upside down to catch beautiful glowing stars! 🌟
hint: You catch bright things from space.

question: Where does a dream train ride? 🚂
explanation: Great job! A magic train can glide smoothly over a bright, colorful rainbow! 🌈
hint: It rides on colors in the sky.

question: What does a magic superhero cape do? 🦸
explanation: Super! A superhero cape catches the wind and lets you fly in the sky! ☁️
hint: It takes you into the air.

question: What happens when you look at a magic clock? 🕰️
explanation: Awesome! A magic clock can send you back in time to meet dinosaurs! 🦕
hint: It does the opposite of normal time.

question: If you draw a super fast turtle, what is on its back? 🐢
explanation: Great job! A turtle with a rocket shell can zoom around super fast! 💨
hint: It is a fast space engine.

question: What can you draw on a spider's feet? 🕷️
explanation: Super! Drawing a spider wearing colorful sneakers is very silly and fun! 👟

question: Where is a magical school built? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! A school in the clouds would let you jump on clouds at recess! ☁️
hint: Look up high in the sky.

question: What does a magic snowman love? ⛄
explanation: Great job! A magic snowman never melts, so he loves relaxing in the hot sun! 🕶️
hint: The warmest season of the year.

question: What does a magic chair do when you sit? 🪑
explanation: Super! A friendly magic chair can wrap its arms around you for a hug! 🤗

question: What does a fantasy book do? 📖
explanation: Awesome! A magic book can read its own stories out loud to you! 📚

question: How does a magic guitar make music? 🎸
explanation: Great job! A magic guitar floats in the air and plays beautiful songs! 🎶
hint: No one needs to touch it.

question: If you color a magic banana, what color is it? 🍌
explanation: Super! In art, you can use your imagination to make a banana blue! 🎨
hint: Pick a color that bananas usually are NOT.

question: How does a dream lion sound? 🦁
explanation: Awesome! It is fun to imagine a big strong lion meowing like a tiny kitten! 🐈
hint: Think of a small pet cat.

question: What does a magic mirror show you? 🪞
explanation: Great job! A magic mirror can show you all the amazing things you will do tomorrow! 🌟
hint: It shows things that haven't happened yet.

question: What is a funny thing to draw on a frog? 🐸
explanation: Super! A frog wearing rain boots is a very creative and silly drawing! 👢

question: What makes a dream balloon special? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! A magic balloon is super strong and will never, ever pop! 🎈

question: Where does a magic playground slide go? 🛝
explanation: Great job! A magic slide can take you on a fun ride all the way to the moon! 🚀

question: When you draw with magic crayons, what happens? 🖍️
explanation: Super! Imagine drawing a puppy and it jumps off the paper to play with you! 🐶

question: What does a fantasy tree use its branches for? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! A friendly tree can reach down and give you a big warm hug! 🌳

question: If you draw a magic backpack, what is inside? 🎒
explanation: Great job! A magic backpack can hold endless toys and games for you! 🧸
hint: It has fun things to play with.

question: What does a dream dinosaur eat? 🦖
explanation: Super! A friendly dream dinosaur loves to share hot pizza with its friends! 🍕
hint: It is a popular food with cheese.

question: Why is it good to use your imagination in art? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! Imagination lets your brain create anything you want in the whole wide world! 🌟
